# NEW 2026-11-21 v7.1 Stage 2 (Wave 2) Package 1: Byzantine Renaissance 3-Way Intellectual Debate (oe_ren_). Generated by gen_byz_renaissance.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Country scope (BYZ/ROM). Byzantine Renaissance 3-Way Intellectual Debate mechanics (oe_ren_).

# Initialize all state variables cleanly (idempotent).
oe_ren_setup = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_init } }
        set_variable = oe_ren_init
        set_variable = oe_ren_active
        set_variable = { name = oe_ren_stage value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ren_school value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ren_academy_tier value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ren_inf_hes value = 40 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ren_inf_neo value = 30 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ren_inf_hum value = 30 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ren_tension value = 15 }
    }
}

# Normalize the three school influence shares to sum to 100 (clamped 5..90 each).
oe_ren_norm_schools = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ren_inf_hes has_variable = oe_ren_inf_neo has_variable = oe_ren_inf_hum }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_ren_inf_hes min = 5 max = 90 }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_ren_inf_neo min = 5 max = 90 }
        clamp_variable = { name = oe_ren_inf_hum min = 5 max = 90 }
        set_local_variable = { name = oe_ren_sum value = var:oe_ren_inf_hes }
        change_local_variable = { name = oe_ren_sum add = var:oe_ren_inf_neo }
        change_local_variable = { name = oe_ren_sum add = var:oe_ren_inf_hum }
        if = {
            limit = { local_var:oe_ren_sum > 0 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ren_inf_hes value = { value = var:oe_ren_inf_hes multiply = 100 divide = local_var:oe_ren_sum round = yes } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ren_inf_neo value = { value = var:oe_ren_inf_neo multiply = 100 divide = local_var:oe_ren_sum round = yes } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ren_inf_hum value = 100 }
            change_variable = { name = oe_ren_inf_hum subtract = var:oe_ren_inf_hes }
            change_variable = { name = oe_ren_inf_hum subtract = var:oe_ren_inf_neo }
            clamp_variable = { name = oe_ren_inf_hum min = 0 max = 100 }
        }
    }
}

# Shift school influences by (hes, neo, hum) and re-normalize.
oe_ren_shift = {
    oe_ren_setup = yes
    change_variable = { name = oe_ren_inf_hes add = $hes$ }
    change_variable = { name = oe_ren_inf_neo add = $neo$ }
    change_variable = { name = oe_ren_inf_hum add = $hum$ }
    oe_ren_norm_schools = yes
}

# Adjust ideological tension (clamped 0..100).
oe_ren_tension_add = {
    oe_ren_setup = yes
    change_variable = { name = oe_ren_tension add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_ren_tension min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Safely raise academy tier (0..3).
oe_ren_academy_bump = {
    oe_ren_setup = yes
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ren_academy_tier var:oe_ren_academy_tier < 3 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_ren_academy_tier add = 1 }
    }
}

# Push institution:renaissance progress in owned core Greek cities (if spawned & not yet present).
oe_ren_push_renaissance = {
    if = {
        limit = { institution:renaissance = { has_spawned = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { location:constantinople = { owner ?= root NOT = { has_institution = institution:renaissance } } }
            location:constantinople = { change_institution_progress = { type = institution:renaissance value = $val$ } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { location:thessaloniki = { owner ?= root NOT = { has_institution = institution:renaissance } } }
            location:thessaloniki = { change_institution_progress = { type = institution:renaissance value = $val$ } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { location:mystras = { owner ?= root NOT = { has_institution = institution:renaissance } } }
            location:mystras = { change_institution_progress = { type = institution:renaissance value = $val$ } }
        }
    }
}

# Push institution:renaissance progress in Constantinople only.
oe_ren_push_renaissance_city = {
    if = {
        limit = { institution:renaissance = { has_spawned = yes } location:constantinople = { owner ?= root NOT = { has_institution = institution:renaissance } } }
        location:constantinople = { change_institution_progress = { type = institution:renaissance value = $val$ } }
    }
}

# Lock chosen school (1=Hesychast, 2=Neo-Platonic, 3=Humanist) and apply its country modifier.
oe_ren_lock_school = {
    oe_ren_setup = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_ren_school value = $school$ }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ren_stage value = 4 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ren_culm_m value = { value = oe_ml_month_now add = 120 } }
    remove_country_modifier = oe_ren_school_hesychast
    remove_country_modifier = oe_ren_school_neoplatonic
    remove_country_modifier = oe_ren_school_humanist
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ren_school ?= 1 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ren_school_hesychast years = -1 mode = replace } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ren_school ?= 2 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ren_school_neoplatonic years = -1 mode = replace } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ren_school ?= 3 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ren_school_humanist years = -1 mode = replace } }
}

# Settle culmination modifier (replaces intermediate school modifier).
oe_ren_set_culm = {
    set_variable = oe_ren_culm_done
    remove_country_modifier = oe_ren_school_hesychast
    remove_country_modifier = oe_ren_school_neoplatonic
    remove_country_modifier = oe_ren_school_humanist
    remove_country_modifier = oe_ren_culm_hesychast
    remove_country_modifier = oe_ren_culm_neoplatonic
    remove_country_modifier = oe_ren_culm_humanist
    remove_country_modifier = oe_ren_culm_compromise
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = $mod$ years = -1 mode = replace }
}

# Close the arc cleanly (called by .14 synthesis or post-1525 safety valve).
oe_ren_finish = {
    set_variable = oe_ren_done
    remove_variable = oe_ren_active
    set_variable = { name = oe_ren_stage value = 5 }
}

# Record event pacing (18 months spacing) and take shared main-line scheduler lock (slot 46).
oe_ren_mark_fired = {
    oe_ml_take_as = { line = 46 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_ren_next_m value = { value = oe_ml_month_now add = 18 } }
}

# Safe Italian diplomatic opinion helper.
oe_ren_italian_opinion = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:FLO } c:FLO = { add_opinion = { modifier = $mod$ target = root } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:VEN } c:VEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = $mod$ target = root } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GEN } c:GEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = $mod$ target = root } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:PAP } c:PAP = { add_opinion = { modifier = $mod$ target = root } } }
}

# Annual passive drift (called every January while oe_ren_active).
oe_ren_yearly_drift = {
    if = { limit = { oe_ecc_hesychast_strong = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_ren_inf_hes add = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_un_made = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_ren_inf_hum add = 2 } oe_ren_tension_add = { amount = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_ren_bloc_holds_mystras = yes } change_variable = { name = oe_ren_inf_neo add = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_sr_strong = yes } oe_ren_tension_add = { amount = -1 } }
    oe_ren_norm_schools = yes
}

# ======================================================================== Monthly Scheduler Entry (slot 46)
# Called by gen_mainline_lock.py (slot 46) on BYZ (also supports ROM). O(1) fast-path before 1380 and after completion.
oe_ren_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ren_is_empire = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_done } current_date >= 1380.1.1 }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_init } }
            oe_ren_setup = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { current_month = 1 has_variable = oe_ren_active }
            oe_ren_yearly_drift = yes
        }
        # Auto-close safety valve after 1525 or if culmination done without City after 1505.
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    current_date >= 1525.1.1
                    AND = { has_variable = oe_ren_culm_done current_date >= 1505.1.1 NOT = { oe_ren_holds_city = yes } }
                }
            }
            oe_ren_finish = yes
        }
        # Discretionary event dispatch: respects shared oe_ml_free lock, 18-month pacing, and calm state.
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_ren_active oe_ml_free = yes oe_ren_pace_ready = yes oe_ren_calm = yes }
            # .10 Ideological Backlash (high priority if tension >= 70, once per arc)
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_ev10_done } has_variable = oe_ren_stage var:oe_ren_stage >= 2 has_variable = oe_ren_tension var:oe_ren_tension >= 70 }
                set_variable = oe_ren_ev10_done
                oe_ren_mark_fired = yes
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ren.10
            }
            # .1 Chrysoloras's Journey to Florence (1390+)
            else_if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_ev1_done } current_date >= 1390.1.1 }
                set_variable = oe_ren_ev1_done
                oe_ren_mark_fired = yes
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ren.1
            }
            # .2 Plethon's Memoranda from Mystras (1415+)
            else_if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_ev2_done } current_date >= 1415.1.1 }
                set_variable = oe_ren_ev2_done
                set_variable = { name = oe_ren_stage value = 2 }
                oe_ren_mark_fired = yes
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ren.2
            }
            # .3 The Imperial Academy Reborn (1422+)
            else_if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_ev3_done } current_date >= 1422.1.1 oe_ren_holds_city = yes }
                set_variable = oe_ren_ev3_done
                oe_ren_mark_fired = yes
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ren.3
            }
            # .4 Council of Florence Scholarly Exchange (1438+)
            else_if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_ev4_done } current_date >= 1438.1.1 }
                set_variable = oe_ren_ev4_done
                oe_ren_mark_fired = yes
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ren.4
            }
            # .5 Plethon's Nomoi Controversy (1452+)
            else_if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_ev5_done } current_date >= 1452.1.1 }
                set_variable = oe_ren_ev5_done
                if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ren_stage var:oe_ren_stage < 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_ren_stage value = 3 } }
                oe_ren_mark_fired = yes
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ren.5
            }
            # .7 Greek Emigres vs Return of the Scholars (1454+)
            else_if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_ev7_done } current_date >= 1454.1.1 }
                set_variable = oe_ren_ev7_done
                if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ren_stage var:oe_ren_stage < 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_ren_stage value = 3 } }
                oe_ren_mark_fired = yes
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ren.7
            }
            # .6 Printing Press of the Golden Horn (1458+)
            else_if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_ev6_done } NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_press_built } current_date >= 1458.1.1 oe_ren_holds_city = yes }
                set_variable = oe_ren_ev6_done
                oe_ren_mark_fired = yes
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ren.6
            }
            # .8 Athonite Monasteries & Hesychast Renewal (1460+)
            else_if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_ev8_done } current_date >= 1460.1.1 }
                set_variable = oe_ren_ev8_done
                oe_ren_mark_fired = yes
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ren.8
            }
            # .9 The Great Debate of Constantinople (1468+, locks school 1/2/3)
            else_if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_ev9_done } current_date >= 1468.1.1 has_variable = oe_ren_ev2_done oe_ren_mid_count >= 2 }
                set_variable = oe_ren_ev9_done
                oe_ren_mark_fired = yes
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ren.9
            }
            # .11 / .12 / .13 Three Distinct School Culminations (1488+ / 10y after .9)
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_ren_culm_ready = yes var:oe_ren_school ?= 1 }
                oe_ren_mark_fired = yes
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ren.11
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_ren_culm_ready = yes var:oe_ren_school ?= 2 }
                oe_ren_mark_fired = yes
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ren.12
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_ren_culm_ready = yes var:oe_ren_school ?= 3 }
                oe_ren_mark_fired = yes
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ren.13
            }
            # .14 Bosporus Renaissance Institutional Synthesis (1495+, after culmination, holds Constantinople)
            else_if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_ren_culm_done NOT = { has_variable = oe_ren_synth_done } current_date >= 1495.1.1 oe_ren_holds_city = yes }
                set_variable = oe_ren_synth_done
                oe_ren_mark_fired = yes
                trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ren.14
            }
        }
    }
}
